description: Edit a .tres (or the sub_resources of a .tscn) and import settings, without the editor. .tres: set/unset properties on [resource] or a sub_resource (`sub`: its id), add_sub (type, optional id), remove_sub; names and types checked against Godot 4.7 (enums by name, resources as res:// or SubResource("id"), byte arrays as [0, 255] or base64:...); uids kept, only changed lines touched. Import (give the asset or its .import): get (key: type, default, choices), diff (options changed from default), set/unset an option (names checked against what the importer reads, enums by name: Forward, VRAM Compressed), per sub-resource with `sub` animations/<name>, meshes/<name>, materials/<name>, nodes/PATH:<node> (loop_mode, shadow meshes, external materials, cast shadow), importer (as: animation_library, scene, image, texture, keep), reimport. Ops run in order; one write. Without `write` it returns the diff. With write a .import is reimported headless and checked: Godot kept each value, output changed or not (an error result when Godot dropped a value or the import failed). godot_undo reverts.

file.description: res://path or a path: .tres, .tscn, an asset or its .import

ops.description: changes or questions, applied in order

sub.description: sub_resource id, or kind/name in a .import

reimport.description: after a .import write, reimport with Godot and verify (default true)

name: godot_resource_edit
title: Change a resource or import settings
